meta.name: Bamini and Boys
meta.description: Three young over-ambitious housemates compete to woo their hot middle-aged landlady.

videos.title: Hellooooo, Boys!
videos.overview: Housemates Utpal, Hardik and Abhinav team up for a quick photoshoot of their charming landlady, Bamini, while trying to win her over. Who will impress Bamini the most?

videos.title: Mr Fix-Its
videos.overview: Abhinav's allergies drive him nuts while Hardik offers to repair Bamini's geyser, hoping for some 'alone' time.

videos.title: Yoga se Hoga
videos.overview: Keep calm and do yoga, unless it's 'hot' yoga with Bamini! Abhinav and Hardik betray Utpal and join her for a yoga session.

videos.title: Raat Gayi, Baat Nahi Gayi
videos.overview: The apartment loses electricity, and the boys jump at the opportunity to keep Bamini company. And a drunken night of truth and dare ensues.

videos.title: Ghostbusters
videos.overview: Abhinav is convinced that Bamini's house is haunted. To make sure she is safe, the boys convince her to spend the night at their place.

videos.title: All In
videos.overview: It's game night, and Utpal is the undefeated champion. But his luck nosedives when Bamini joins the game. Is it Bamini's charm or something else?

videos.title: Zip It
videos.overview: It's a race to zip Bamini's dress. She is getting ready for an event, and one lucky boy could get a chance to help her dress. Who will it be?

videos.title: Golmaal Hai
videos.overview: Bamini's boss hires a new anchor to cover a music launch. Hardik takes it upon himself to distract the new anchor and get into Bamini's good books.

videos.title: Who Dat?
videos.overview: Bamini asks the boys to pick up Harsh. The boys are convinced that Harsh is Bamini's boyfriend and vow to show him an unpleasant time. Soon, the tables are turned.

videos.title: Have You Seen it?
videos.overview: The boys discover a new steamy movie that leaves them fantasizing about romancing Bamini. But they have to somehow stop Harsh from blurting this out to her!

videos.title: It’s Not Me, It’s You
videos.overview: Bamini helps Hardik rehearse for his audition. Things go south when Abhinav spots them rehearsing and assumes they are "together".

videos.title: The High and Short of it
videos.overview: Utpal stains Bamini's gorgeous dress. He teams up with Hardik to try and remove the stain, only to ruin it further. Meanwhile, Abhinav tries his best to distract Bamini.

videos.title: Hot Mess
videos.overview: The boys volunteer to help Bamini clean her room. However, they organise it a little too well. When Bamini can't find her dress, Hardik seeks Madhavi's help.

videos.title: Fake It Till You...
videos.overview: Abhinav ends up injuring Utpal's prospective client. The girl shows up with a lawyer ready to sue all three boys! How will they wiggle their way out of this?

videos.title: Stampede for Lampshade
videos.overview: Bamini can't find her lucky heirloom lamp. Hardik and Utpal go on a mission to replace it, while Abhinav makes a new 'friend'.

videos.title: Daane Daane pe Likha Hai...
videos.overview: Madhavi plans a date night with Hardik, while Bamini invites him to her event. Hardik is spoilt for choice - Madhavi or Bamini?

videos.title: Pyaar Dosti Hai
videos.overview: Abhinav cancels his special evening with Shreya to let Hardik and Madhavi celebrate their one-month anniversary. But things go downhill when Madhavi breaks up with Hardik for underperforming.

videos.title: Tedhi Medhi
videos.overview: Utpal and Abhinav have got the perfect remedy to mend Hardik's broken heart - spending the night with Bamini! But will performance pressure get to him?

videos.title: Meet the Parents
videos.overview: Under severe "meet the parents" pressure from Shreya, Abhinav ends up sabotaging the evening. Is this the end of their relationship?

videos.title: Lose It All
videos.overview: The boys organise a surprise birthday party for Bamini. While the party goes a little too well, the group is in for a nasty surprise in the morning.
